name: DEEP Robotics
summary:
DEEP Robotics develops quadruped robots, humanoid platforms and core robotic components for embodied-intelligence applications. Its product range includes industrial inspection quadrupeds, the DR humanoid series and joint modules, supported by perception, navigation and motion-control technology.

The company develops an integrated perception–decision–execution stack, combining environmental sensing with movement and task control. Its application areas include energy infrastructure, emergency response, industrial operations, research and education. This gives it a portfolio spanning machines built for difficult terrain and platforms for broader physical interaction, with robot hardware, software and deployment services developed as connected parts of the business.
